title: Efficient Adjoint Matching for Fine-tuning Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.11480v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reward fine-tuning has become a common approach for aligning pretrained diffusion and flow models with human preferences in text-to-image generation. Among reward-gradient-based methods, Adjoint Matching (AM) provides a principled formulation by casting reward fine-tuning as a stochastic optimal control (SOC) problem. However, AM inevitably requires a substantial computational cost: it requires (i) stochastic simulation of full generative trajectories under memoryless dynamics, resulting in a large number of function evaluations, and (ii) backward ODE simulation of the adjoint state along each sampled trajectory. translated_title: 面向扩散模型微调的高效伴随匹配
translated_abstract: 奖励微调已成为在文本到图像生成中将预训练扩散模型和流模型与人类偏好对齐的常用方法。在基于奖励梯度的方法中，伴随匹配通过将奖励微调转化为随机最优控制（SOC）问题，提供了一种有原则的建模框架。然而，AM不可避免地带来巨大的计算开销：它需要（i）在无记忆动力学下对完整的生成轨迹进行随机模拟，导致大量的函数评估次数；（ii）沿每条采样轨迹对伴随状态进行反向ODE模拟。在本工作中，我们观察到这两个瓶颈都与从预训练模型继承的非平凡基础漂移密切相关。受此观察启发，我们提出高效伴随匹配，通过使用线性基础漂移对SOC问题进行重构，显著提升了训练效率。
tldr: 提出高效伴随匹配（EAM），通过将随机最优控制问题重构为线性基础漂移形式，避免了完整轨迹的随机模拟和伴随状态的反向ODE计算，大幅降低了扩散模型奖励微调的计算成本。
en_tdlr: Proposes Efficient Adjoint Matching (EAM), which reformulates the stochastic optimal control problem with a linear base drift, eliminating costly full-trajectory stochastic simulation and backward adjoint ODE computation, thereby substantially improving training efficiency in reward fine-tuning of diffusion models.
